supported: setup (TTY wizard + non-interactive flags/JSON; privacy defaults OFF)
doctor (read-only structured diagnostics; --json; network opt-in or when configured)
privileged broker status (fail-closed metadata; native service management unsupported)
notes: The Rust EXPLICIT_UNSUPPORTED_CLI_SURFACES and ADDITIONAL_UNSUPPORTED_CLI_SURFACES registries are authoritative. Every unsupported entry returns a machine-visible hard error; unregistered command strings are rejected at runtime. Parser presence, a marker file, or a generated service template is not treated as implementation. v1.1.0 onboarding implemented setup, doctor, and user-level service lifecycle (Windows current-user Scheduled Task ONLOGON, macOS LaunchAgent, Linux systemd --user). These are distinct from the privileged broker, which remains unsupported for install/uninstall. Additional surface notes: exec --device never falls back to local; session open <device> never falls back to local; privileged broker install/uninstall are side-effect-free unsupported operations (no templates, markers, or process spawns) until a secure mint authority exists; privileged broker status reports fail-closed metadata only.
